name: ArgoCDInstall
description: Download, verify and cache the argocd CLI, and add it to PATH.
helpMarkDown:
[Documentation](https://github.com/WayneGoosen/azdo-argocd-tasks) | [Report an issue](https://github.com/WayneGoosen/azdo-argocd-tasks/issues)

The tool cache only persists on self-hosted agents. On Microsoft-hosted agents this downloads roughly 250 MB every run, so prefer **ArgoCDApp@1** unless you need something the REST API cannot do.
author: WayneGoosen

inputs.name: version
inputs.label: Version

options.server: server - match the Argo CD server (needs a service connection)
options.vX.Y.Z: explicit - type a version such as v3.5.3

inputs.helpMarkDown: `server` guarantees the CLI matches the server you are talking to. Type an explicit version such as `v3.5.3` to pin.

inputs.name: connection
inputs.label: Argo CD service connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: Required when Version is `server`, or when Source is `server`. Not needed for `latest` or an explicit version.

inputs.name: source
inputs.label: Download from

options.auto: auto - the Argo CD server when it can serve this agent, otherwise GitHub
options.server: server - always the Argo CD server (Linux agents only)

inputs.helpMarkDown: The Argo CD server re-serves its own binary, so it can only supply a **Linux** CLI matching its own architecture. Everything else comes from GitHub.

inputs.name: verifyChecksum
inputs.label: Verify SHA-256 checksum
inputs.helpMarkDown: Verify GitHub downloads against `cli_checksums.txt`. Leave on: it is the only thing that catches a truncated download. Does not apply to server downloads, which serve the server's own build.

outputVariables.name: argocdPath
outputVariables.description: Full path to the argocd binary.

outputVariables.name: argocdVersion
outputVariables.description: Version tag that was installed, e.g. v3.5.3.
